body:
Hey. I'm just a 20 year old college kid who's dabbled in drugs quite a bit. I'm up in Canada and fentanyl is making its rounds around here. I managed to get some candies dipped in 5mg Acetyl Fentanyl.
Perhaps they were bunk or not really 5mg but I kept redosing and couldn't get any euphoria from these. Some itching, a bit of a nod for 10 minutes. But I just couldn't get very high from these...
Perhaps they were less than 5mg in actuality. I have pretty much no opiate tolerance so this was very surprising.
Overall one of the worst opiates I've tried. I even got more euphoria from codeine. This was nothing like heroin which is the buzz I had hoped for.
